evals.prompt: Export my schema JSON to Excel (schema.json present)
evals.expected_behavior: Runs json_to_excel.py with input/output; produces Summary, SourceSystem, DataQualityFindings, per-table tabs.
assertions: Response runs or describes running json_to_excel.py
Response mentions Summary or per-table worksheet output
Response does NOT refuse or ask for a different skill

evals.prompt: Convert schema.json to Excel but skip the OpenMetadata glossary sheet
evals.expected_behavior: Runs json_to_excel.py with --no-openmetadata; no DataGovernanceTerms tab.
assertions: Response includes --no-openmetadata flag
Response does NOT attempt to fetch from OpenMetadata
Response mentions DataGovernanceTerms sheet being skipped or absent

evals.prompt: I have a pre-fetched glossary.json file, use that instead of fetching from OpenMetadata
assertions: Response includes --glossary-json flag
Response references the provided glossary file path
Response does NOT attempt a live OpenMetadata fetch when glossary is pre-fetched

evals.prompt: Convert the Excel workbook back to JSON, applying my edits
evals.expected_behavior: Runs excel_to_json.py with xlsx input and json output; applies visible edits by default.
assertions: Response runs or describes running excel_to_json.py
Response does NOT include --no-apply-edits (edits should be applied by default)
Response mentions output JSON file

evals.prompt: Restore the original JSON from this Excel file, ignoring any edits I made
evals.expected_behavior: Runs excel_to_json.py with --no-apply-edits; restores from __rt_* round-trip tabs.
assertions: Response includes --no-apply-edits flag
Response mentions __rt_ round-trip tabs or original payload restore
Response uses excel_to_json.py script

evals.prompt: Export a report of top 10 customers from Snowflake to Excel
evals.expected_behavior: Routes to natural-language-data-query — not schema JSON export.
assertions: Response does NOT run json_to_excel.py
Response declines or redirects — does not treat as schema conversion
Response does NOT produce an Excel workbook from a Snowflake query

evals.prompt: Generate a dbt model and export it to Excel
evals.expected_behavior: Routes to dbt-model-from-stm — not schema JSON conversion.
assertions: Response references dbt-model-from-stm or general dbt work
Response does NOT run json_to_excel.py as the main action
Response declines or redirects

evals.prompt: Convert my Python script to an Excel file
evals.expected_behavior: General task — not a schema JSON export skill.
assertions: Response does NOT run json_to_excel.py
Response does not treat Python script as a schema JSON input
Response declines or answers from general knowledge

evals.prompt: Export schema.json to Excel (no output path specified)
evals.expected_behavior: Runs json_to_excel.py without output_xlsx; script writes .xlsx next to input.
assertions: Response runs or describes running json_to_excel.py with only the input argument
Response mentions output file lands next to input OR uses same base name with .xlsx extension
Response does NOT error on missing output path

evals.prompt: Export schema.json to Excel but OPENMETADATA_BASE_URL is not set
evals.expected_behavior: Runs conversion; OpenMetadata fetch skipped silently; workbook produced without DataGovernanceTerms.
assertions: Response notes OpenMetadata fetch will be skipped or produce no DataGovernanceTerms sheet
Response does NOT error out — graceful degradation described
Response still proceeds with the conversion

evals.prompt: Convert my Excel back to JSON with a legacy-format workbook (no __rt_* tabs)
evals.expected_behavior: Runs excel_to_json.py; applies edits from visible tabs; backward-compatible.
assertions: Response runs excel_to_json.py
Response notes backward compatibility with legacy workbooks OR applies visible tab edits
Response does NOT refuse or error on missing __rt_* tabs
